yea_policy_direction: indeterminate omnibus appropriations package
human_review_note: Rejected as a candidate-position anchor because the omnibus supplemental appropriations package prevents attribution of the vote to its Corrections Department provision.

yea_policy_direction: restructures parole administration and imposes more standardized criteria and oversight on parole decisions
human_review_note: Accepted as a conservative criminal-justice anchor concerning parole restriction and oversight; provision-level claims require full text.

yea_policy_direction: removes the protected Tutwiler women's-prison earmark and gives ADOC greater flexibility to reallocate correctional funds
human_review_note: Accepted as marginally conservative on criminal/social justice and conservative on budget policy. Supporters emphasized administrative flexibility during the General Fund crisis; opponents emphasized protection of funding, inmate conditions, and legislative oversight. Context sources are partly retrospective rather than a direct floor-debate transcript.

yea_policy_direction: increases penalties for attempted, solicited, and conspired Class C felonies; expands habitual-offender enhancements to Class D felonies; and permits longer incarceration instead of mandatory split sentences
human_review_note: The enrolled text shows a predominantly punitive measure. Limited mitigating and procedural provisions do not outweigh felony reclassification, habitual-offender enhancements, expanded revocation grounds, and judicial authority to impose longer incarceration.

yea_policy_direction: substantially reduces correctional incentive-time credits, lengthens the time required to reach higher earning classifications, and expands circumstances for forfeiting credits
human_review_note: Reclassified from economic development to criminal justice. Yea favors longer effective prison terms and more restrictive good-time eligibility.

yea_policy_direction: supports discretionary and transferable tariff tax credits for industrial projects investing at least $100 million and creating at least 100 qualifying jobs
human_review_note: Accepted as a targeted-industrial-policy and large-project-subsidy anchor, not as generic pro-business or free-market conservatism. The bill included wage and job thresholds, reporting, clawbacks, a sunset, and broad executive discretion.

yea_policy_direction: supports and constitutionally validates a discretionary program allowing approved companies to retain a portion of employee income-tax withholding for qualifying job-creation and retention projects
human_review_note: Accepted as a targeted-industrial-policy anchor. HB159 constitutionalizes and shields the HB160 incentive program; a Yea favors state-directed incentives and executive flexibility, while a Nay may reflect free-market, fiscal, constitutional, or corporate-subsidy concerns. Do not assign a simple liberal-conservative score.

yea_policy_direction: requires a municipality or municipal public authority abating county taxes for economic development to abate the corresponding municipal tax at the same rate
human_review_note: Accepted as a secondary, marginally conservative signal of local fiscal restraint and intergovernmental accountability. The measure limits municipalities' ability to grant abatements involving another local government's revenue without sharing the concession; it is not opposition to industrial incentives generally.

yea_policy_direction: expands long-term ad valorem and construction-related transaction-tax abatements for qualifying data centers and logistics facilities while reducing the data-center employment threshold
human_review_note: Accepted as a targeted-industrial-policy anchor, not a general economic-conservatism measure. The enrolled act permits sector-specific abatements lasting up to 30 years, preserves education taxes, establishes capital and employment thresholds, and includes protections against counting certain replacement jobs as new employment.

yea_policy_direction: prohibits governmental entities from using covered public contracts or other governmental pressure to advance economic boycotts targeting a bundle of protected industries, environmental and corporate-governance choices, firearms activity, and refusals to facilitate abortion or gender-transition care
human_review_note: Accepted as a bundled conservative anti-ESG governance anchor. It is suitable as an overall ideological signal but not as a clean anchor for any single component issue; a vote should not be interpreted as separately establishing the legislator's position on every protected activity.

yea_policy_direction: redirects the entire net proceeds of the scrap-tire environmental fee from dedicated remediation, enforcement, and program uses to the State General Fund for fiscal years 2013 and 2014
human_review_note: Accepted with dual coding. Yea favors temporary General Fund flexibility over dedicated environmental revenue and deprioritizes scrap-tire remediation and enforcement funding for two years. Treat as a moderately strong, time-limited budget-priority signal rather than evidence of broad environmental hostility.

yea_policy_direction: expands the wildlife-collection permit law to all protected wild invertebrate and vertebrate species and their eggs, creates tiered $10 to $100 permits, and sets the misdemeanor fine at three times the applicable permit fee
human_review_note: Accepted as substantive factual state-issue evidence but excluded from ideological scoring. The regulatory and fee changes were technical and overwhelmingly bipartisan, so coding them as progressive would overstate their ideological content.

yea_policy_direction: supports coordinated water-resource planning, conservation credits, and restrictions on water allocation under specified conditions
human_review_note: Accepted as conservation-oriented factual state-issue evidence but excluded from ideological scoring. Near-unanimous bipartisan support indicates technical water-resource management rather than a discriminating ideological position; full text was not required for this limited coding.

yea_policy_direction: raises the annual waterfowl-hunting stamp from $5 to $10 and authorizes future Consumer Price Index adjustments through the existing hunting- and fishing-license process
human_review_note: Accepted as a meaningful rural and hunting constituency position but not a conventional left-right ideological anchor. Yea supports a higher inflation-indexed hunter user fee; Nay prioritizes keeping the direct cost to waterfowl hunters lower.

yea_policy_direction: requires more frequent electronic campaign-finance reporting, expands reporting requirements for Section 527 organizations and large contributions, and establishes a state electronic disclosure database
human_review_note: Accepted as a campaign-finance transparency and government-reform position. It is suitable for the ethics/government matrix but has no reliable conventional left-right direction; association with Alabama's 2011 Republican reform agenda should not be mistaken for inherent conservative valence.

yea_policy_direction: requires disclosure to the Ethics Commission of the names and compensation of public officials and their spouses who are employed by or contract with the state or a local government
human_review_note: Accepted as a pro-transparency and conflict-of-interest disclosure anchor. It is suitable for the ethics/government matrix but has no reliable conventional left-right direction; its 2011 partisan context does not make the underlying disclosure policy inherently conservative.

yea_policy_direction: expands the category of minor ethics violations eligible for consent-based administrative resolution, raises the maximum administrative fine from $1,000 to $6,000, and makes an approved administrative resolution preclude later state or local criminal prosecution
human_review_note: Accepted as a mixed ethics-enforcement reform with a net movement toward less criminal treatment of lower-dollar or mitigating violations. The final act omitted the introduced bill's investigation rewrite. It measures administrative proportionality versus stricter criminal exposure, not a conventional left-right position.

yea_policy_direction: requires all covered campaign-finance reports to be filed electronically without the prior exceptions
human_review_note: Accepted as a clean pro-transparency and administrative-modernization position with low comparative value because support was nearly unanimous. Retain as factual issue evidence but do not treat as a conventional left-right signal.

yea_policy_direction: restricts public-assistance purchases of alcohol, tobacco, and lottery tickets and restricts benefit use or withdrawal at specified establishments
human_review_note: Conservative benefit-use and moral-regulation anchor. Treat as predecessor and corroboration for SB116 rather than an independent equally weighted signal.

yea_policy_direction: restricts public-assistance purchases and use at specified establishments, provides benefit sanctions, permits third-party receipt for children, and adds ATM blocking and eligibility checks
human_review_note: Primary conservative benefit-use restriction anchor. Substantially overlaps SB7, which should not be double-weighted.

yea_policy_direction: increases retiree PEEHIP cost-sharing through service- and retirement-age-based premiums, permits spousal-coverage surcharges, caps employer contributions, and eases board voting requirements for changing costs
human_review_note: Conservative public-employee-benefit retrenchment anchor. The act retains income-based assistance for households at or below 300 percent of the federal poverty level.

yea_policy_direction: requires at least 10 years of creditable coverage for state retiree health benefits, increases cost-sharing through sliding-scale premiums, permits spousal-coverage surcharges, and eases board voting requirements for changing costs
human_review_note: Conservative state-employee-benefit retrenchment anchor with income-based assistance retained for lower-income participants.

yea_policy_direction: imposes a temporary annual secondary nursing-facility privilege assessment of $401.28 per bed contingent on a minimum General Fund Medicaid appropriation
human_review_note: Specialized Medicaid-financing anchor rather than a general tax vote. The provider assessment was treated as an allowable Medicaid reimbursement cost, making its conventional left-right valence mixed.

yea_policy_direction: prohibits deliberately providing aid in dying and establishes civil and criminal penalties
human_review_note: Clear socially conservative assisted-suicide prohibition anchor.

yea_policy_direction: authorizes health care providers to decline services that violate their conscience and provides remedies against adverse consequences
human_review_note: Clear conservative health-care conscience-rights anchor.

yea_policy_direction: raises the maximum bid guarantee for covered public-works bids from $10,000 to $50,000
human_review_note: Technical procurement and contractor-responsibility measure. Retain as factual evidence but exclude from ideological scoring.

yea_policy_direction: creates a Class C felony when a person causes a death while knowingly violating a non-DUI vehicle-operation law and that violation is the proximate cause
human_review_note: Conservative punitive criminal-justice anchor. The enrolled text requires a knowing traffic violation and proximate causation and excludes the separate DUI statute.

yea_policy_direction: authorizes public-private design, finance, ownership, operation, and maintenance arrangements for road, bridge, and tunnel projects costing at least $100 million
human_review_note: Moderately conservative pro-market infrastructure-delivery anchor. The act also requires project-selection procedures and permits best-value rather than price-only procurement.

yea_policy_direction: allows safe removal of drivable vehicles after crashes without apparent serious injury or death and authorizes state personnel to assist with limited immunity
human_review_note: Technical highway-administration and incident-clearance measure. Retain as factual evidence but exclude from ideological scoring.

yea_policy_direction: requires school districts to give all professional educator associations the same level of access to public-school employees
human_review_note: Conservative labor and association-competition anchor that reduces the incumbent AEA's potential preferential access and benefits competing educator organizations.

yea_policy_direction: exempts locally approved members of the public from interpreter or transliterator licensing for emergency or incidental services to public-school students
human_review_note: Narrow deregulatory and local-control anchor. Weight below broader ideological measures because the exception may also address practical interpreter availability.

yea_policy_direction: caps annual Education Trust Fund appropriations and establishes budget-stabilization and capital funds
human_review_note: Strong conservative fiscal-restraint and reserve-policy anchor.

yea_policy_direction: requires nongovernmental tax-exempt persons and companies to obtain annual exemption certificates and requires specified exempt-transaction reporting
human_review_note: Tax-compliance and administrative-reporting measure without reliable conventional left-right valence. Retain as factual evidence but exclude from ideological scoring.

yea_policy_direction: extends the claim period and permits one- to four-year carryforwards for capital tax credits tied to qualifying new or expanding business projects
human_review_note: Targeted-industrial-policy and business-incentive anchor with mixed conventional left-right valence.

yea_policy_direction: applies Alabama tax rules to certain vehicles removed for out-of-state registration while capping Alabama tax at the amount due in the destination state
human_review_note: Technical reciprocal vehicle-sales-tax and revenue-administration measure. Retain as factual evidence but exclude from ideological scoring.
